editorial.blurb: Lee Wing Wah brings authentic Chinatown energy with a few standout dishes, though the experience can be as inconsistent as the kitchen's execution.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Beef and Noodles or Crunchy Garlic Ribs on a busy Saturday night when the kitchen is at its best—just be prepared that service can be rushed, and always verify your bill before paying to avoid surprise automatic gratuities.
